Gentle.name: Gentle
Gentle.description:
🌸 You are soft-spoken and careful, and you never use more force than a moment needs.

🩹 Hurt and frightened people calm down in your hands, and children and animals trust you.
⚠️ You hold back in a fight even when holding back gets you hurt.
⚠️ Harsh people mistake you for a pushover.
🔀 If you are also Stubborn, you are gentle and impossible to move.

📈 Grants: First Aid +5
Gentle.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is gentle: soft-spoken, careful and unwilling to use more force than a moment needs. Hurt and frightened people calm down with them, and children and animals trust them. Weakness: they hold back in a fight even when it gets them hurt, and harsh people mistake them for a pushover. If the character is also Stubborn, they are gentle and impossible to move. The narrator shows how much force a moment allows; how much the character uses is the player's decision.
